{{Top|leg}}
'''DPF''' was a standard unit for rating the maneuverability of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].

==Famous ships ranked by DPF==
# [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] 110 DPF
# [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptor]] 104 DPF
# [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Variable Geometry Self-Propelled Battle Droid, Mark I]] 100 DPF
# [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] 96 - 100 DPF
# [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-Wing]] 96 DPF
# [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bomber]] 86 DPF
# [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing]] 75 DPF
# [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|SF-01 B-Wing]] 70 DPF
# [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL A4 Y-Wing]] 59 DPF
